title: Add adapter and image optional dependency fail-closed replay
purpose: Prove adapter and image packs fail closed when optional dependencies are missing and never fall back to unsafe host behavior.
scope: Replay adapter pack with missing host dependency.
Replay image pack with missing KVM or Firecracker.
Record denied outcomes and provenance hashes.
acceptance_criteria: Missing optional dependency fails before EffectPrepared.
Denied reason is visible in projection.
failure_modes: Adapter uses host fallback after missing dependency.
Image pack activation reaches EffectPrepared without required image.
